# proxmox_node_ceph_filesystems (Data Source)

Lists Ceph filesystems from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/fs`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_filesystems" "f" { node = "pve-1" }
```

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only
